name: FormVFX
title: motion graphics and visual effects compositing on your own machine
summary: FormVFX is a motion graphics and VFX compositor with 306 effects, a Rust engine, OpenFX and WebAssembly plug-ins, tracking, roto and a Render Queue.
lede: FormVFX is a motion graphics and visual effects compositor for the desktop and the browser. It has compositions, layers, keyframes and the Graph Editor, 306 effects, text animators with 169 presets, 3D cameras and lights, tracking, roto and a Render Queue, with an agent harness so Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can drive every tool.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux, in a browser or as a Tauri 2 desktop app
checks: Composites with layers, precomps, shapes, text, masks, track mattes, 39 blend modes and layer styles on the GPU through wgpu or on the CPU.
Animates with keyframes, the Graph Editor, expressions, behaviours, two-bone IK, 2D physics and cloners.
Loads OpenFX plug-ins and sandboxed WebAssembly effect plug-ins, and opens Template Controls templates (.mogrt) and .aep projects.
Renders through a Render Queue to H.264, HEVC, AV1, ProRes 4444, WebM, GIF, PNG, TIFF, EXR, WAV and AIFF.

facts.dd: .fvxproj; .ecproj and .ecprojx projects from earlier releases open as imports
Its own compositing engine in Rust (native/fvx-core), loaded by a Python engine service
Through FFmpeg when installed; stills, image sequences, OpenEXR, PSD, PDF, .ai and Lottie on its own

chapters.title: Layers, effects and a GPU compositor
chapters.text: Compositions, precomps, shape layers, text with animators, masks, track mattes and 306 effects, with keying, Color Grade, OCIO transforms, particles and simulations. The compositor renders on the GPU when the engine finds a working adapter.

chapters.title: Keyframes, graphs and procedural motion
chapters.text: Keyframes with eases and roving keys, the Graph Editor, Wiggler, Smoother and Motion Sketch, expressions on its own interpreter, stackable behaviours, two-bone IK rigs, 2D physics baked to keyframes and cloners.

chapters.title: Track, stabilize and cut out
chapters.text: Point, planar and mask tracking, face tracking, Wrap Stabilization and the 3D Camera Tracker, plus Roto Paint and Object Matte with FormVFX's own MobileSAM and SAM 2 runtimes.

features.title: Compositions and layers
features.text: Compositions, precomps, solids, shapes, text, nulls, cameras and lights.
bullets: Track mattes, 39 blend modes and layer styles
Shape layers with every standard operator and tapered, wavy and dashed strokes
SVG import and paste as shapes
8, 16 and 32-bit projects with colour management, OCIO and ACES

features.title: 306 effects
features.text: Effects with the Expression Controls, and a Liquify tool.
bullets: Keying, Color Grade and the OCIO transforms
The 3D Channel set on OpenEXR passes and Cryptomatte
Particles and simulations, immersive video and 13 audio effects

features.title: Text and shapes
features.text: Text with character styles, OpenType features and variable fonts.
bullets: Text animators with range, wiggly and expression selectors
169 text animation presets
Text on a path and per-character 3D
Shapes and masks from text

features.title: Keyframes and the Graph Editor
features.text: Eases, roving keys and tools for refining motion.
bullets: Keyframe Assistant, Wiggler, Smoother and Motion Sketch
Time stretch, time remapping and freeze frames
Stackable procedural behaviours: wiggle, oscillate, spring, bounce, loops
Data-driven animation from CSV and JSON

features.title: Rigs and simulation
features.text: Puppet pins, two-bone IK and 2D physics.
bullets: Two-bone IK rigs with an FK switch
2D physics baked to keyframes
Cloners with live per-copy offsets

features.title: 3D
bullets: Cameras with depth of field and lights with soft shadows
glTF, GLB and OBJ models, 3D primitives and MaterialX materials
Extruded and bevelled text and shape layers
Classic and Advanced 3D, 360 VR environments and stereo 3D rigs

features.title: Tracking and roto
bullets: Point, planar and mask tracking
Face tracking on the learned MediaPipe Face Landmarker
Wrap Stabilization and the 3D Camera Tracker
Roto Paint and Object Matte with MobileSAM and SAM 2
Selection-Aware-Fill

features.title: Plug-ins, scripts and templates
bullets: OpenFX plug-ins with on-screen handles and sandboxed WebAssembly effect plug-ins
Scripts with ScriptUI windows and CEP extension panels
Template Controls templates (.fvxtemplate and .mogrt) with Primary Properties
.aep projects read by its own RIFX reader

features.title: Render Queue and output
features.text: Render Settings, several output modules and templates.
bullets: H.264, HEVC, AV1, ProRes 4444, WebM, GIF, PNG, TIFF, EXR, WAV and AIFF
Field rendering, pulldown and multi-frame rendering
A render Watch Folder
Lottie export and layered PSD and EXR frames

features.title: Editor interchange and Live Link
features.text: Timelines in and out of editors, and live clips.
bullets: xmeml 5 XML, FCPXML, OpenTimelineIO and CMX 3600 EDL
Export Live Link Clip writes a .fvxlink that an editor such as FormCut plays with no render
Links survive moving or renaming the project

features.title: Panels and Flowchart
features.text: Project, Effect Controls, Composition viewer, Timeline, Effects and Presets, Preview, Character and Render Queue.
bullets: Cmd or Ctrl+K searches every command and effect
The Flowchart is also a node editor for parenting, mattes and effect order
Idle preview caching shown as a green strip on the time ruler
Adaptive Resolution keeps scrubbing light

features.title: Agents and the command line
features.text: Claude Code starts inside the app, already connected.
bullets: Window > Start Claude Code (Shift+Cmd or Ctrl+J) in the Terminal panel
Chat with Claude panel (Alt+Cmd or Ctrl+J)
Codex and Cursor start from the Terminal panel's buttons
./formvfx state, commands, describe, exec, batch, frame and render

parity.summary: 72 After Effects capability rows, re-graded at 0.51.5 by tracing the code: 68 Full, 3 Partial, 1 None, a score of 69.5 of 72 (97%). Fusion, Nuke, Flame, Autograph and EffectCraft are the other columns.

docs.agents: Claude Code starts inside the app already connected; .mcp.json, .codex/config.toml and .cursor/mcp.json run ./formvfx mcp, and ./formvfx agents install sets up all three clients.

topics.title: Getting started
topics.text: Open http://localhost:5250, choose Open the demo project on the start screen and work in the panels; ./formvfx doctor checks the toolchain.

topics.title: The engine
topics.text: The README names native/fvx-core, the Rust engine that renders on the GPU through wgpu or on the CPU; docs/MANUAL.md goes through the application area by area.

topics.title: Plug-ins
topics.text: docs/PLUGINS.md covers WebAssembly effect plug-ins and OpenFX plug-ins.

topics.title: Commands
topics.text: ./formvfx with no arguments prints every command: install, install-native, serve, doctor, claude, mcp, agents, counts, presets and clean among them.

topics.title: Parity
topics.text: docs/PARITY.md grades FormVFX line by line on 72 rows and lists where it trails and where it leads.

items: Agent guardrails for roto propagation and Selection-Aware-Fill
Licence documentation: frozen packages, shell crates, NOTICE in the installers
Own names for five features in the interface
Feature names updated in README, NOTICE, manual and wiki
